The '''King of the Dragonsnakes''' was a large [[Dragonsnake/Legends|dragonsnake]] living on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] in the [[Dragonsnake Bog/Legends|Dragonsnake Bog]] near [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|Yoda's hut]] during the years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

== Biography ==

=== Early life ===
The biggest of his species, a large specimen of [[Dragonsnake/Legends|dragonsnake]] had dominated his [[Dragonsnake Bog/Legends|swamp]], and the other dragonsnakes suffered due to his greed. They lived only off the scraps the King left behind, leaving the swamp unbalanced.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Luke Skywalker and the Treasure of the Dragonsnakes]]''</ref> Few of his victims had been lucky to escaping it.<ref name=":4">{{FactFile|4|DAG 1-4|Dagobah}}</ref>

=== First encounter with Luke Skywalker ===
[[File:SWAdventures3cover.jpg|thumb|405x405px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] faced several times the King of the Dragonsnakes while on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref>''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the King of the Dragonsnakes was eating a [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwing]] it had just killed when it was interrupted by the arrival of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]'s [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]<ref name=":0" /> as the boy was in search of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name=":1">{{Film|V}}</ref> While the other dragonsnakes scattered, the King did not hide<ref name=":0" /> and assaulted his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]],<ref name=":1" /> assuming it was food.<ref name=":0" /> It moved behind it too quickly and too obscured by the mist for Luke to clearly identify it, as all he could see was a massive dark form<ref name=":2">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> of a large [[Snake/Legends|serpent]]-like creature rolling through the water.<ref name=":3">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> This creature rose up for a moment, showing its dorsal fin, then dove beneath the surface,<ref name=":1" /> making a loud bang against the little droid's metal hull.<ref name=":2" /> 

It swallowed [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]<ref name=":1" /> whole,<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> but then spat him out after realizing that he was indigestible.<ref name=":1" /> It found the droid's taste to be wrong, and it broke a tooth while biting it,<ref name=":0" /> and it also realized that it could not digest a [[Metal/Legends|metal]] object.<ref name=":4" /> After his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] landed on the shore,<ref name=":1" /> Luke noticed some alien [[Bone/Legends|bones]] on the ground nearby, and he wondered if they'd been expectorated by the same creature that had tried to make a meal of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name=":3" /> After that, the King of the Dragonsnakes waited for the opportunity to strike at Skywalker himself, expecting him to be softer and tastier.<ref name=":0" /> For the two visitors, the dragonsnake was the first of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]'s residents to introduce itself.<ref name=":4" /> 

=== Defeat ===
When the opportunity presented itself several days later, the King of the Dragonsnakes found out that his prey was armed with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and Skywalker managed to harm the King and escape. The other Dragonsnakes saw the King's failure as a sign of his weakness. Humbled, the King retreated to his [[Lair of the King of the Dragonsnakes|Lair]]. Skywalker, accompanied by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], followed him there and confronted the King in his very own lair. Using his knowledge of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he subdued the King to his will and retrieved his prize&mdash;an egg of an [[Accipiptero/Legends|Accipiptero]]. Afterwards, the other Dragonsnakes were no longer afraid of the King, and the swamp returned to balance.<ref name=":0" />

== Personality and traits ==
A massive [[Dragonsnake/Legends|dragonsnake]], it was so big and fierce to become the "[[King/Legends|King]]" of its [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, while being big and strong, it was weak-minded and took advantege of his size to act as a bully.<ref name=":0" />
